name: Sunset Yellow FCF
aliases: E110, INS 110, sunset yellow FCF, sunset yellow, orange yellow S, FD&C Yellow No. 6, FD&C Yellow 6, Yellow 6
what_is: A synthetic food colour identified in the EU as E110.
why_botia: BOTIA flags E110 because EU Regulation 1333/2008 places it among the colours for which specified foods must carry the additional statement that the colour may have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children, subject to the regulation's exceptions. This is a labelling requirement, not a prediction of an effect in a particular child.
can_1: Detect E110 and the principal declared names for Sunset Yellow FCF.
can_2: Show the EU additional-labelling context without converting the warning rule into an individual medical conclusion.
cannot_1: Determine the amount of colour present from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Predict whether a particular child will experience an effect or assume that the same warning wording applies in every jurisdiction.
